text: 你拿出的实体证据说服了几乎所有偏执的反对者。大学开始认真讨论此事，电台和报纸记者纷纷要求采访你。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 274
text: The physical evidence you produce convinces all but your most biased opponents. The university brings the topic under serious discussion. Journalists from radio and newspapers clamor to interview you.
